title: 污水化學除磷
summary: 本課以金屬鹽化學計量、膠體分離與新增污泥為主線，從除磷目標與成分、元素莫耳配比、活性成分日量、藥液濃度與密度進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops metal-salt stoichiometry, colloid separation and added sludge through ten connected units, beginning with phosphorus target and fractions, elemental molar ratio, daily active-component mass, solution fraction and density. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 除磷目標與成分：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Phosphorus target and fractions: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 除磷目標與成分 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Phosphorus target and fractions and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先界定需移除的是溶解正磷酸鹽還是顆粒磷，避免把過濾問題當缺藥。
steps.instructionEn: Define dissolved versus particulate removal before mistaking filtration failure for chemical shortage.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.
steps.failure: 總磷高但溶解磷低可能是固體流失。診斷與介入：重測總磷與溶解磷，將固體分離和水相反應分開診斷。
steps.failureEn: High TP with low dissolved P can indicate solids escape. Diagnostic response: Remeasure total/dissolved P and diagnose solids separation separately from aqueous reactions.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「除磷目標與成分」的觀測點。對照總磷消化分析與過濾樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for phosphorus target and fractions. Compare digested total-P analysis with filtered samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 TP:6→8 mg P/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 15 變為 20 kg P/d。用「除磷目標與成分」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only TP:6→8 mg P/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 15 to 20 kg P/d. Explain the direction using phosphorus target and fractions, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「污水化學除磷」的「除磷目標與成分：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「再生水品質交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Phosphorus target and fractions: Mechanism and observation” in “Chemical phosphorus removal from wastewater”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Water-reuse quality handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 元素莫耳配比：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Elemental molar ratio: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 元素莫耳配比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Elemental molar ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沉澱化學計量以莫耳而非藥液公斤計；實際共沉澱偏離理想比。
steps.instructionEn: Precipitation stoichiometry uses moles, not kilograms of solution; real co-precipitation differs from ideal ratios.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：P=10 kg/d；假設 Fe/P=1.5 mol/mol；原子量 Fe=55.85、P=30.97。模型 Fe=P r×55.85/30.97，代入得到 27.050371 kg Fe/d。適用邊界：是假想元素鐵需求，不是商用藥劑投加量；共沉澱與副反應需瓶杯試驗。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: P=10 kg/d; assumed Fe/P=1.5 mol/mol; atomic masses Fe=55.85, P=30.97. Model Fe=P r×55.85/30.97 gives 27.050371 kg Fe/d. Applicability: Hypothetical elemental-Fe demand, not a commercial reagent dose; co-precipitation and side reactions require jar testing.
